displayName: Disable Microsoft Office shared drawing code for metafile rendering (User)
description: Disables nearly all EMF's and WMF's will no longer be converted at runtime to be anti-aliased.  Examples of EMF/WMF's that would remain "aliased" are: clipart, OLE object placeholders, any user inserted EMF/WMF image, etc.  Any EMF/WMF containing text would be an exception to this and would be still getting anti-aliased.
